edits.old_text: Temperature acts on the algorithm only through the fork. Dividing the fork logits by T predicted the minority share at each temperature before sampling within the committed error on Gemma's grid task (mean absolute error 0.026) and on minimum spanning tree weight (0.083, with the observed drop twice the predicted one), just outside it on trapped rain water (0.105), and not in direction on valid anagram, where a second decision follows the fork.
edits.new_text: Temperature acts through one or two decision tokens whose logits fix the odds. Dividing the fork logits by T predicted the minority share before sampling within the committed error on Gemma's grid task (mean absolute error 0.026, pass) and on minimum spanning tree weight (0.083, pass), although there the T 1.0 prediction (0.237) lies outside the observed Wilson 95% interval for 20 of 50 ([0.28, 0.54]) and the stream-lean explanation (the twin's 20 of 100 against the sweep's 20 of 50, Fisher p 0.011) is post hoc; it fails on trapped rain water (0.105, which has a second opening with its own split) and on valid anagram, which has a second decision a few tokens after the fork (iteration-8 correction).
